titulo: DEVO v2 — Coruja, retrato em pose (meio corpo, ref. Persona)
prompt: Bold clean anime lineart, two-tone cel shading, high-contrast graphic poster style. Half-body portrait from mid-thigh up, plain flat medium grey background, headroom above the head. A tall elegant woman in her thirties in three-quarter view, turned toward the viewer's right, head tilted, heavy-lidded amber eyes, faint knowing smile; her right hand near her chin holds one face-down card with a geometric owl-eye back, relaxed hand, five fingers clearly separated; her other arm rests under her capelet. Near-black braided crown, a narrow straight white streak from the braid to the chin on the viewer's left, a loose wavy lock on the viewer's right, two long steel hairpins rising like owl ear tufts, gold crescent earrings. High white collar and lace jabot with a gold owl brooch; dark bottle-green vest with gold trim; short brown capelet with a scalloped hem of small diamonds. Cool moonlight from above, thin green rim light. Palette: black #0C0C0E, library green #2F7A55, warm brown #6B4A32. No text, letters or logos anywhere.
negative: text, letters, watermark, logo, blurry, low detail, pixel art, extra fingers, extra limbs
